existingSteps.currentText: Gather four dry grass and four firewood; craft a firestarter from two diagonal sticks. Sneak-right-click one dry grass onto solid ground, then right-click it with four firewood. Save another dry grass for separate tinder and two for torches.

existingSteps.currentText: Clay-form and pit-fire a pot and bowl. Put the fired pot in the firepit, fill its ingredient slots with a valid meal recipe and matching portion counts, then cook. Right-click the cooked pot with an empty bowl to serve.
